fields.title: Fields

comment.description: Why the data was asked for, as the requester wrote it.
comment.title: Comment

outcome.description: `ok`, or the code of the refusal.
outcome.title: Outcome

comment.description: Why the data is needed. Shown to every member as written; its length after trimming is bounded by the server settings.
comment.title: Comment

expires_at.title: Expires At

grants.description: One per member asked: who and how they answered, no data.
grants.title: Grants

actor_id.description: The account that made the change, none when the system did.

new_person_id.description: The person the account stands for after, none when it has no one.

old_person_id.description: The person the account stood for before, none when it had no one.
old_person_id.title: Old Person Id

records.description: One record per stored row (a passport with its name variant, a contact, the person's profile): field key to value, a field of several columns as an object of them.
records.title: Records

What a subject or a grantee sees: the stored status, or `expired` once the
request has run out.
GrantState.title: GrantState

id.description: Keeps and changes an existing contact; one left out is deleted.
id.title: Id

is_main.description: The main contact of its type. Exactly one of a type is main: the first one marked, else the first of that type.
is_main.title: Is Main

student.description: Left out or null: the user is not a student.

get.description:
Who opened the caller's sensitive data, or tried to, and when; newest first.
Empty for an account without a person.
The caller's own requests, newest first.

post.description:
The leader of a confirmed collective asks its active members for fields, with
a comment that says why. Every member gets a pending grant and a notice; the
request, its fields, comment and term never change.

get.description: The fields a leader may ask the members of a collective for.

schema.title: Response Get Access Fields Profile V2 Access Requests Fields Get

get.description: How each member answered; no data. Only for the one who asked.

post.description:
The fields of the members whose grant is active, for the leader who asked
while they still lead the collective and the members still belong to it. The
rest are listed in `skipped`. Each export is journaled and told to every member
it covers.

get.description:
Who linked, moved or unlinked which account, how and when; newest first.

`person_id` matches a change that took the person from an account or gave
it to one.

parameters.description: Comma-separated fields, prefix a field with `-` for descending order. Allowed: created_at, action, source.
parameters.name: order_by

schema.description: Comma-separated fields, prefix a field with `-` for descending order. Allowed: created_at, action, source.
schema.title: Order By

post.description:
Finds the record by its name, whatever the case and spacing, or makes it.

Every endpoint of this router works so: what several profiles share is
looked up first and added only when it is missing.
A faculty is the same one when its university and name are.

get.description:
Requests for the caller's data: who asks, in which collective, for what,
why and until when; newest first.

post.description:
Opens the asked fields to the leader until the request expires. Held back
(`409 GRANT_COOLDOWN`) for a while after the account link changed.
Closes an approved grant for good; a new request is needed to ask again.

get.description:
Whether personal data can be encrypted and decrypted now; `503` when a key
provider does not answer. The liveness probe stays `/profile/v1/health`.

post.description:
Whom an invitation is for, read by whoever holds the token.

`400 INVITE_TOKEN_EXPIRED` for an old token and `400 PERSON_ALREADY_HAS_ACCOUNT`
when the person has registered already.
For a workplace: an organization, or a university, with that name.

The full names of the requested persons.

Every requested id gets an entry. The name is left out when the caller may not see
it or the person does not exist: the two look the same.

A token that lets its bearer register an account for the person, 
or attach the person to an account they already have.

400.description: The person already has an account

put.description: An administrator sets the audience; the change is kept with `source=admin`.

get.description:
The caller's whole profile: name, birthdate, diet, student card, contacts.

`404 PROFILE_NOT_FOUND` until the user has made one.

post.description:
Makes the caller's profile in one transaction and links it to the account.

A user makes one profile for themselves: a second attempt is
`403 PROFILE_ALREADY_EXISTS`. The access token carries the linked person
only after its next refresh; profile endpoints do not depend on it.

409.description: The account claims a person that the profile service has no link for

put.description: Replaces the whole profile: a student card or a contact left out is removed.

post.description: Superuser only: a profile picks a degree, it does not make one.
A group is the same one when its faculty and name are.

get.description: Who may see each personal field of the caller; the defaults without a person.

delete.description: Returns the field to its default audience.

put.description:
Sets the audience of a field. Narrowing is always allowed; widening is held
back (`409 VISIBILITY_COOLDOWN`) for a while after the account link changed.
